notes.title: THE OUTREACH Demo is out now!
notes.content:
[b]The demo for THE OUTREACH is free to play and now available as part of the Steam Next Fest![/b] Download the demo from our Steam store page. If you enjoy the demo, wishlist the full game and expect more content coming soon!
